title: The Bolt
description: One Bolt. Fifteen minutes. The PO gave your Agent one line: "customer feedback portal." The Agent drafted a plan, drafted an architecture, and is about to execute. But this is AI-DLC — AI proposes, humans verify. Validate the spec, curate the context, verify the architecture, watch the Agent execute, then ship under a countdown. Every room is a beat of the AI-DLC loop: Inception, Context, Construction Design, Verify, Operations.
